tool_input.content:
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

# 1) partial-output type on timeout in text mode
try:
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", "import sys,time;print('partial');sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(30)"],
        text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=1, check=False,
    )
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    print("python", sys.version.split()[0])
    print("stdout repr:", repr(exc.stdout), "isinstance str:", isinstance(exc.stdout, str))

# 2) does timeout kill grandchildren spawned by a shell wrapper?
with open("/tmp/tochk-wrapper.sh", "w") as fh:
    fh.write("#!/bin/sh\npython3 -c \"import time;time.sleep(60)\" &\nwait\n")
os.chmod("/tmp/tochk-wrapper.sh", 0o755)
try:
    subprocess.run(["/tmp/tochk-wrapper.sh"], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=2, check=False)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    pass
time.sleep(1)
survivors = subprocess.run(
    ["pgrep", "-fa", "time.sleep(60)"], text=True, capture_output=True, check=False
).stdout.strip()
print("grandchild survivors after timeout:", survivors or "<none>")
subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "time.sleep(60)"], check=False)
